title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Service Agent in Microsoft 365 as a dedicated service specialist
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, Public Preview billing, prerequisites and blocking controls are supported. The changed Agent 365 service description still supports tenant-wide tool governance. Two minor corrections remain: narrow the impact rationale's audience gap and cite the API overview that establishes the relationship between agents and catalog packages.
